campaign: 2 m/s target ramp + age-gated terminal flare
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
purpose: Combine the lower-drift 2 m/s target ramp with the age-gated 8 m flare; compare with the safer 1 m/s + flare variant.
scenario: 30 m settled, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 directions x 10 seeds; 20 s outage 43-63 s and 60 s outage 43-103 s
verdict: Drift/roll-priority variant, not the default. It cuts drift substantially (20 s 530 -> 259 m, 60 s 517 -> 362 m) and improves median roll, but the touchdown p95 is 4.43 m/s vs 1.02/3.30 for the 1 m/s + flare. The 1 m/s + flare remains the safer opt-in because touchdown tail is the safety-critical metric; 2 m/s + flare requires landing gear/impact attenuation.
caveats: SIL plant has no landing gear/impact model; touchdown speeds are kinematic.
Opt-in macros, default off; not real aircraft.
